_comment: Copy to controller/config.json (gitignored) — local machine config, never committed. Env vars override: DEEPHOUSE_MUSIC, DEEPHOUSE_BRIDGE_IP, DEEPHOUSE_APP_KEY.
_music: serve.py streams audio from this local folder. Audio never lives in this repo. Absent = the piece runs silent.
_bridge: listen.py reads these to reach the Hue bridge. They are NOT in listen.py on purpose — that file is committed, and a key pasted there would be in git history permanently. Same values as HueEngine.cs (BridgeIpAddress / AppKey).
_buttons: Run: python controller/listen.py --discover. Copy each button UUID here. These IDs identify your own remote, so keep the filled file private.
